summary_claims.claim: Digitaliseringsstyrelsen, Datatilsynet and Domstolsstyrelsen designated as national competent authorities (s. 2); Agency is notifying authority and single point of contact (s. 2(2)). Literal: 'The Agency for Digital Government, the Data Protection Agency and the Courts Administration are designated as national competent authorities'.
Authorities may enter business premises without a court order and order a temporary ban if an AI system may pose a risk (ss. 6, 8(2)).
